brief.audience: For research, news, operations, and office teams
brief.casesTitle: What problems have I worked on?
brief.casesSubtitle: Start with a problem your team recognizes.

cases.title: Lots of reports, but the knowledge base still answers badly
cases.problem: Documents are ingested, yet answers are off and citations are unreliable.
cases.solution: Finance knowledge base: improve parsing, chunking, search, and citation ranking.
cases.result: Answers stay closer to the source and can be checked and expanded for team use.

cases.title: Scans, tables, and complex PDFs are hard to use
cases.problem: Scans cannot be read cleanly, while tables and document structure get lost.
cases.solution: Complex document processing: extract text, tables, sections, and layout into searchable data.
cases.result: Difficult files become usable input for Q&A, extraction, and analysis.

cases.title: Data inside report charts cannot be found
cases.problem: Text is searchable, but chart numbers and conclusions remain hidden.
cases.solution: Joint text-and-chart retrieval for reports, returning both types of evidence.
cases.result: Search covers charts as well as text and reduces manual page checking.

cases.title: Collecting and organizing reports by email takes too much time
cases.problem: People download, rename, register, and extract report attachments by hand.
cases.solution: Automated report collection: watch mailboxes and extract structured information.
cases.result: Fewer missed files and less repetitive entry into downstream workflows.

cases.title: Too much news to sort and prioritize
cases.problem: Classifying, tagging, and distributing announcements manually is slow.
cases.solution: Financial news classification by topic, company, event, and business labels.
cases.result: Teams can filter important items before summarizing, pushing, or researching.

cases.title: Intraday changes are easy to miss
cases.problem: Markets and news move too quickly for a person to watch continuously.
cases.solution: Intraday monitoring that checks market and news signals and sends alerts.
cases.result: Move from noticing changes late to receiving timely signals for research decisions.

cases.title: An AI assistant demos well but cannot handle complex work
cases.problem: Long, multi-role tasks drift and are difficult to ship reliably.
cases.solution: Multi-agent workflows that split research, checking, and summarization into roles.
cases.result: Complex processes become easier to review, hand off, and release step by step.

brief.toolsSubtitle: Each item below builds on an existing project.
brief.toolsNote: These are reusable project bases, not off-the-shelf products. A trial still needs samples, permissions, data connections, and acceptance criteria.

tools.title: Complex PDF and scan processing
tools.fit: Teams with scans, tables, or stamped documents
tools.output: Extracted text, tables, sections, and layout.
tools.setup: Confirm sample quality, fields, and output format.

tools.title: Report chunking and chart retrieval
tools.fit: Teams building a finance knowledge base or report Q&A
tools.output: Semantic chunks for text and tables with joint retrieval.
tools.setup: Tune industry terms, chunk rules, and evaluation questions.

tools.title: Automated report collection
tools.input: Mailbox, attachment samples, and fields to extract.
tools.output: Collect attachments, organize files, and extract structured data.
tools.setup: Connect the mailbox and configure file and field rules.

tools.title: Financial entity and metric extraction
tools.fit: Teams organizing companies, people, dates, and metrics from reports
tools.input: Report samples and entity types to watch.
tools.output: Extract companies, sectors, metrics, dates, and other key facts.
tools.setup: Add domain vocabulary and calibrate with samples.

tools.title: Automatic news and announcement tagging
tools.fit: Teams processing large volumes of finance news
tools.output: Classify and label content for filtering, summaries, and distribution.
tools.setup: Confirm category levels and boundary examples.

tools.title: ETF and trade anomaly monitoring
tools.status: Existing monitoring project · data feed needed
tools.fit: Research teams that need timely market signals
tools.input: Market data, instruments, and alert conditions.
tools.output: Monitor signals and push alerts with related information.
tools.setup: Connect the data source and agree on indicators and channels.

tools.title: Knowledge-base Q&A API
tools.fit: Teams connecting Q&A to an existing system
tools.input: Document sources, permissions, and Q&A scenarios.
tools.output: A standard Q&A API with citations and call records.
tools.setup: Connect identity, data sources, and business systems.

tools.title: Multi-tool workflow orchestration
tools.fit: Teams automating query, organize, and review steps with AI
tools.input: Connected systems and one concrete workflow.
tools.output: Plan and run tool calls in order from a natural-language request.
tools.setup: Connect tools and define permissions, boundaries, and approval points.

brief.conversationTitle: Three questions to ask a finance team
questions: Which repetitive task takes the most time every day?
Where does the data live, and can you share a sample?
What would a useful result from a small trial look like?
brief.conversationNote: Start with reports, document extraction, news tagging, or market alerts. A sample makes it clear what can be reused and what needs custom work.
